name: Digital Countdown Timer
description: Keep track of the cooking of your next culinary masterpiece, or just clock a round of charades or word game with this handy kitchen timer. This 2.24" x 2.13" x 0.63" plastic timer has three-button operation and an easy-to-read LCD display that keeps track of up to 99 minutes and 59 seconds of time before sounding the alarm. Each includes a battery, and has a fold-out stand and magnet mount. Add your logo to create a gift or giveaway from a kitchen supply store, bakery or restaurant.

details.price_includes: one color one location imprint and shipping cost
